caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional bust of a woman with long, brown hair styled in loose waves and braided sections hanging over her shoulders. She is dressed in a loose, light-colored robe with blue-green decorative trim around the cuffs, neckline, and hem. A red-brown belt with a yellow-gold clasp cinches the garment at her waist. Her right hand is placed over her chest, while her left hand rests against a black and gray scroll-patterned object at her side. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are no additional objects depicted in the scene. The figure’s gaze is directed upward, and her facial features and hands are rendered with naturalistic shading.
title: Figurehead from "Julia Lawrence"
